items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: Jack says, “Come on up.” He says, “What do you want to play, Gate?” ... a month later he sent a telegram to the school, trying to locate a piano ... and I answered right back.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because some kids in the audience said, “Hey Jack, we’ve got a piano player here.” And I’m shrinking back, I don’t want to — but anyway, Jack says, “Come on up.” He says, “What do you want to play, Gate?” And I said I think my dad’s favorite tune “Back Home in Indiana.” So that’s how I — and then a month later he sent a telegram to the school, trying to locate a piano — this was back during World War II and he was losing musicians. And so they located me and I answered right back.
